title: Our missing friend texted the group chat
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark, moody, low key lighting, 35mm film grain, desaturated, realistic, suburban American house at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: Our missing friend just texted the group chat.

scenes.narration: Our missing friend just texted the group chat.

shots.prompt: close up of a smartphone glowing on a dark bedroom desk showing a group chat, blue light, night

overlays.text: why did you all leave me out here

scenes.narration: Jake had been gone a week. His phone was dead. The police said so. His mom still left his porch light on every night.

shots.prompt: dark teenage bedroom wall covered in school photos, a phone glowing on the bed

scenes.narration: Eleven of us were in that chat. Nobody typed a word. We just watched the dots appear and vanish. Appear and vanish. Someone was trying to type.

shots.prompt: smartphone screen showing a typing indicator in a group chat, dark room, blue glow

scenes.narration: Then a photo came through. A dark road. Trees on both sides. A flashlight pointing at the ground.

shots.prompt: narrow dark country road at night with trees on both sides, a small flashlight beam on the asphalt, no people

scenes.narration: I knew that road. It ran behind my house. I looked out my window. A small light glowed between the trees.

shots.prompt: bedroom window at night, curtains parted, a tiny light glowing far away between black trees

scenes.narration: Another message. Please come get me. I'm so cold. I almost went. I already had my shoes on. My hand was on the door.

shots.prompt: hand holding a glowing phone in a dark hallway, sneakers on the floor, front door in the background

overlays.text: please come get me. i'm so cold

scenes.narration: Then one more. Don't come. It's using my phone. It wants you outside. Stay inside. Please.

shots.prompt: smartphone lock screen in the dark, notification glow on a wooden floor

overlays.text: DON'T COME. it's using my phone

scenes.narration: The light between the trees went out. A moment later, it appeared in my yard. Right under my window.

shots.prompt: backyard lawn at night under a bedroom window, a small light glowing on the grass, no person visible

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you go outside, or lock the door?

overlays.text: Go outside, or lock the door?

shots.prompt: close up of a smartphone glowing on a dark bedroom desk showing a group chat, blue light, night
